text:
Claire H (Finance): FYI ZenByte invoice ZB-710 failed auto-pay this AM. Stripe reports `expired_card`. Card on file expired 01/26.
Ben R (BillingOps): I see it. No backup method. Customer is on monthly, small-medium ARR. Standard flow?
Maya L (CS): I messaged their AP. They said their procurement rotated cards last week and forgot to update us. They prefer to pay by ACH but can update card if we send a secure link.
stripe-bot: Event: payment_method.attached / payment_intent.payment_failed {"code":"expired_card", "amount":"125000"} posted.
Ben R (BillingOps): Proposed: schedule 3 retries at 24h, send secure one-time payment link, offer ACH wiring instructions via encrypted email, allow 48h grace before restricting usage.
Claire H (Finance): Approve 48h grace. For monthly plans we avoid immediate cutoff. Ben, set retries and mark invoice ZB-710 as "pending - retry scheduled". Maya, please send secure link and ask if they want ACH instructions.
Maya L (CS): Will do now. I'll cc billing and note that if they add card we can attempt manual charge.
Ben R (BillingOps): Done: retries scheduled (24h x3), invoice flagged, internal note: "expired card - customer to provide new method or ACH; grace 48h".
Maya L (CS): Update: AP replied, will add new card today and asked for ACH details as fallback. I sent secure link and initiated encrypted wire template with instructions. Asked for remittance email when sent.
Claire H (Finance): Important: don't paste routing or account numbers in channel. Use secure email only.
stripe-bot: Charge succeeded (manual) amount 1250.00 USD - invoice ZB-710
Ben R (BillingOps): Payment confirmed. Added contact to account for future fallback and recommended adding ACH as backup.
Claire H (Finance): Great. Closing thread. Thanks everyone.
